releaseTitle: v1.5.2 - Tinder/Chat Input Bar Filter & True In-App Update Installer
releaseNotes:
• Filtered out chat input bar UI ('GIF', 'Message..', 'Message...') and day/time headers ('Wednesday 7:02 pm', 'Today 2:16 pm', 'Sent')
• Fixed in-app update to download directly into app cache with live progress and launch the installer inside the app instead of leaving a separate APK in Downloads
